news.title: Sreeleela Steps Onto the Sets of Rajinikanth's Dharman in Mysuru
news.summary: Actress Sreeleela has joined the production of Rajinikanth's upcoming Tamil film Dharman, directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and produced by Kamal Haasan. The project also features Ram Pothineni, Raashi Khanna, and Simran in key roles with music by Anirudh Ravichander. Sreeleela was recently spotted on location in Mysuru where shooting is currently underway.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya Gears Up for Milestone 25th Project with Director Clax
news.summary: Naga Chaitanya is preparing to launch his 25th feature film, to be directed by Bedurulanka helmer Clax and backed by producer Bunny Vas with Allu Aravind presenting. The actor is currently awaiting the December release of his high-budget mystical thriller Vrushakarma, directed by Karthik Dandu Varma. Official launch events for his landmark 25th film are slated for October.

news.title: Rumors Surface Regarding Allu Arjun's Character in Lokesh Kanagaraj Collaboration
news.summary: Speculation has arisen that actor Allu Arjun might portray multiple characters, including a police officer, in his upcoming pan-India project AA23 directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj. While the makers have not officially verified these character details, the venture is being produced by Mythri Movie Makers with music by Anirudh Ravichander. Allu Arjun is presently occupied with Atlee's ambitious production Raaka before moving to this film.

news.title: Anand Deverakonda Starrer Epic - First Semester Eyes October OTT Premiere
news.summary: Following an underperforming theatrical run after its September 11, 2026 release, Sithara Entertainments' Epic - First Semester is reportedly heading toward a digital premiere on October 9, 2026. The Aditya Hasan directorial features Anand Deverakonda and Vaishnavi Chaitanya alongside Sivaji, with music composed by Hesham Abdul Wahab. An official announcement regarding the digital release date and potential multilingual streaming is still pending.

news.title: September Box Office Struggles Except for Nani's Starrer
news.summary: The Telugu film industry experienced a largely underwhelming box office month in September 2026 with multiple releases underperforming. Nani's The Paradise emerged as the highest-grossing release of the month despite facing harsh reviews and a negative campaign.

news.title: Glimpses From the Pre-Release Gathering of Dont Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Images from the promotional pre-release event of Dont Trouble The Trouble have captured public attention online. The gathering featured notable appearances and generated buzz among film enthusiasts.

news.title: Jr NTR Returns in High Spirits at Public Gathering
news.summary: Actor Jr NTR delighted fans by appearing jovial and relaxed as the chief guest for a recent pre-release event. Having recovered from an injury, he confirmed that he will soon resume shooting for his upcoming movie Dragon, which remains on track for its scheduled release.

news.title: Mythri Movie Makers Face Financial Pressure on Two Major Productions
news.summary: Top production house Mythri Movie Makers is navigating heavy financial stakes and delays with two high-budget ventures, Fauzi starring Prabhas and Dragon directed by Prashanth Neel. Both projects have exceeded their original budgets and schedules, increasing the pressure for strong theatrical returns.

news.title: NTR and Prashanth Neel's Dragon Maintains June 2027 Premiere Schedule
news.summary: Mythri Movie Makers producer Ravi Shankar has put rumors to rest by confirming that the NTR and Prashanth Neel action film Dragon remains firmly scheduled for an 11 June 2027 release. NTR is set to resume filming action sequences starting October 10, with shooting scheduled to continue without interruption through February 2027. The high-profile project features NTR as an assassin alongside a supporting cast that includes Anil Kapoor, Rukmini Vasanth, and Biju Menon.

news.title: Makers Reveal Khushboo's Traditional Look for Mahakali The End
news.summary: The team behind Prashanth Varma Cinematic Universe's Mahakali The End has unveiled the first look of senior actress Khushboo in a homely avatar to mark her birthday. Directed by Puja Aparna Kolluru and backed by Riwaz Ramesh Duggal, the film stars Bhumi Pednekar and Akshaye Khanna, with its digital streaming rights already acquired by Netflix. The project features a West Bengal backdrop and music composed by Samran Sai.

news.title: Karthik Subbaraj Reveals Direct-to-OTT Netflix Project Starring Upendra and Prabhu Deva
news.summary: While promoting the upcoming Telugu release of Dorothy, director Karthik Subbaraj shared details about his next directorial venture, a direct-to-OTT Netflix film. The upcoming project features Upendra, Prabhu Deva, and Atharva in prominent roles and draws inspiration from a novel centered on Puliyattam. Production is already underway, with a portion of the movie having completed filming ahead of schedule.

news.title: Yash Starrer Toxic Misses October OTT Lineup After Box Office Run
news.summary: The digital premiere of the Geetu Mohandas directorial Toxic has hit another roadblock as the film was omitted from ZEE5's newly announced October streaming schedule. Following an underperforming theatrical run after its August release, fans who anticipated an OTT debut in late September or October must continue waiting for a new streaming date. The high-budget venture produced by KVN Productions features an ensemble cast including Yash, Kiara Advani, and Nayanthara.

news.title: Unplanned Leak Sparks Sudden Online Interest in Thella Kagitham
news.summary: The upcoming youthful romance movie Thella Kagitham, starring Harsh Roshan and Nakshatra, has unexpectedly grabbed social media attention following a leaked bold clip. Directed by Ramesh Badreddy, the film initially experienced low pre-release publicity, but the recent leak has triggered widespread online discussions. The production team is now capitalizing on this buzz to sustain public curiosity as the release date approaches.

news.title: Jr NTR Praises Fahadh Faasil at Don't Trouble The Trouble Event
news.summary: Young Tiger NTR attended the pre-release celebration of Fahadh Faasil's upcoming direct Telugu debut, Don't Trouble The Trouble, as the chief guest in Hyderabad. During the event, NTR expressed his admiration for Fahadh's acting and wished the movie massive success. He also shared personal anecdotes about producer S.S. Karthikeya and confirmed that shooting for Dragon will resume shortly.

news.title: Urvashi Rautela Initiates Massive Legal Battle Against US AI Firm
news.summary: Actress Urvashi Rautela has reportedly sought ₹7,000 crores in damages from a Los Angeles-based artificial intelligence corporation for unauthorized commercial exploitation of her identity. Her representatives firmly warned the firm against using her name, images, and videos without explicit permission. This incident highlights growing concerns among celebrities regarding personality rights and the unauthorized misuse of digital likenesses.

news.title: Jr NTR Amplifies Hype for Dont Trouble The Trouble at Pre-Release Gathering
news.summary: Jr NTR attended the pre-release event of Dont Trouble The Trouble as the chief guest, praising actor Fahadh Faasil and director Sashank Yeleti's upcoming film. He also shared an emotional bond with producer Karthikeya, thanking him for supporting SS Rajamouli's vision. The movie is scheduled to hit theaters on October 2nd.

news.title: Early Buzz Surrounds Naga Chaitanya's Milestone 25th Project
news.summary: As Naga Chaitanya wraps up his ongoing film Vrushakarma under Karthik Dandu's direction, discussions regarding his 25th venture have surfaced online. Industry chatter points to debutante Saatvika Veeravalli as the leading lady, with Bedurulanka fame Clax taking the directorial reins.

news.title: Jr NTR and Rajamouli's Family Share Emotional Gathering at DTTT Event
news.summary: The pre-release function for Dont Trouble The Trouble turned into an emotional reunion between Jr NTR and SS Rajamouli's family members. Rajamouli expressed high confidence in the script, while attendees commended Fahadh Faasil's lead performance. The film releases on October 2nd.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya Locks Romantic Musical for NC25 Under Prominent Banners
news.summary: Following his upcoming release Vrushakarma, Naga Chaitanya has officially greenlit his landmark 25th movie as a musical love story. Backed by Geetha Arts, Annapurna Studios, and Bunny Vas, the project will be directed by Clax and stars Sathvika Veeravalli opposite the actor.

news.title: Trivikram Confirms Script for NTR Venture is Complete
news.summary: Director Trivikram has shared that his upcoming mythological project with NTR has a finalized script ready for production. However, he noted that an official title has not yet been locked in for the film. Pre-production activities are anticipated to get underway soon.

news.title: Team Members Respond to The Paradise Controversial Scene
news.summary: Director Srikanth Odela and actor Nani have addressed the heavy criticism surrounding a particular dialogue in their current release, The Paradise. Odela explained that the mother character's unexpected remark stemmed from sudden astonishment at her daughter's acting talent. Nani added that the weak contextual setup caused the emotional pay-off to miss the mark with viewers.

news.title: Fresh Details Emerge on NTR and Trivikram's Upcoming Collaboration
news.summary: Filmmaker Trivikram Srinivas has provided new insights regarding his next venture with leading man NTR, confirming the script is fully prepared. The movie is scheduled to roll onto sets in 2027. Meanwhile, Trivikram is occupied with his upcoming release Aadarsha Kutumbam, and NTR is filming Dragon with Prashanth Neel.

news.title: Roshan and Preity Mukhundhan Star in Emo Emo Idi Track
news.summary: The title track for Emo Emo Idi, featuring Roshan Meka and Preity Mukhundhan, has been released to showcase a soothing romantic melody. Composed by Hesham Abdul Wahab, the song features vocals by Karthik and Ramya Behara against snowy backdrops. The Sailesh Kolanu directorial is scheduled to hit theaters on October 30, 2026.

news.title: Tollywood Faces Major Roadblocks As Streaming Giants Slash Budgets
news.summary: Streaming platforms have significantly reduced acquisition budgets, creating severe financial hurdles for Tollywood filmmakers. With digital buyers offering much lower figures than expected and linking payouts to theatrical success, producers are forced to rethink their financial models and prioritize box-office earnings.

news.title: Trivikram Confirms Script Lock For Jr. NTR's Mythological Project
news.summary: Director Trivikram has shared an exciting update regarding his upcoming collaboration with Jr. NTR, revealing that the script for the Lord Murugan-inspired mythological film is fully completed. Backed by S. Radha Krishna and Kalyan Ram with music by Anirudh, the big-budget venture is scheduled to begin filming in 2027.

news.title: Director Trivikram Shares Fresh Details on NTR's Upcoming Mythological Epic
news.summary: While promoting his latest family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam, director Trivikram provided fresh insights into his upcoming high-budget mythological film with Jr. NTR. He confirmed that the script is finalized and pre-production will kick off shortly after his current film's release, with filming expected to start once NTR wraps up Prashanth Neel's Dragon.

news.title: Satyadev's Ecological Action Thriller Samavarthi Generates Massive Hype
news.summary: The teaser for Satyadev's upcoming ecological action thriller Samavarthi has crossed one crore digital views, substantially boosting industry and audience expectations. Directed by Ajay Nag V and produced under Rudra Pictures and Panchabhuta Productions, the film features an intense forest-based setting and is slated for a multi-language release later this year.

news.title: Samavarthi Teaser Generates Strong Interest and Market Buzz
news.summary: The recently released teaser for Samavarthi has successfully grabbed audience attention and created a strong positive momentum for its business prospects. The promotional video highlights distinct elements that have sparked conversations among film enthusiasts.

news.title: Diverse OTT Lineup Features Multiple Telugu Releases This Week
news.summary: Streaming platforms are rolling out a fresh selection of movies and series between September 28 and October 4. The roster includes various regional projects and dubbed titles catering to digital audiences.

news.title: Teja Sajja to Anchor The Traitors Telugu on Prime Video
news.summary: Actor Teja Sajja is stepping into the hosting role for the upcoming reality competition The Traitors Telugu on Prime Video. Set to premiere globally on October 15, the 10-episode series will pit 20 participants against each other in a game of deception and strategy.
